items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: you’ve heard Benny Carter and others talk about how they got a bum deal out of it

ctx.x: Were those the V-discs, or was that something different?

No, these were big, well they were as big as LPs really. And they were jazz — well you’ve heard Benny Carter and others talk about how they got a bum deal out of it but there’s still a lot of them that are under wraps that you can’t get. But they’d ship those over and lots of them. And we had movies on the submarines. I saw “Destination Tokyo” at least five hundred times.
Did you guys chuckle sometimes at the way the war was portrayed in films?
